subject: [hw] lead: include/redwood_vcodec.h rev 2 (RWVC_DMA_INFO nr 12, RWVC_DMA_SHARED) + redwood_jpeg.h comment; per-process client identity accepted
body: Approved hw-ip proposal as written: struct rwvc_dma_info { uint32_t handle, bytes, out_pa, reserved; }; RWVC_DMA_INFO = RWVC_IOC(0xc0000000u, 12, ...). Errors: EINVAL handle 0, ENOENT unknown, EPERM not usable by the caller. Rule (now in the header): a file may use a handle it allocated, or one allocated with RWVC_DMA_SHARED (=1u, now defined in the header: remove local defines) by a file of the OTHER minor. hw-ik: per-process client identity is accepted and documented in the header. redwood_jpeg.h: the KERNEL trims to the last FF D9 (K01 does); out_bytes is exact. Owners to act: hw-k02 (implement RWVC_DMA_INFO in n2vc_ioctl_locked + test), hw-ik (allow nr 12 on both minors, refresh the header copies, make_patch, compile_check), hw-p03 (n2vc_hw_dev/transport helper for it if hw-ip asks), hw-ip (wire it, drop the E_ARGS path).
